scenes.say: Ever spent too long trying to line up elements? Let's see how Flexbox makes layouts easy.

scenes.label: Flexbox
scenes.sub: A one-dimensional layout tool for rows or columns.
scenes.say: Flexbox is built for arranging items in a row or a column. It's perfect for simple, flexible layouts.
Here, display flex turns your container into a flexbox. Justify content spreads out the items, and align items centers them along the cross axis.
Use Flexbox when you only need to control one direction. For both rows and columns, switch to Grid.

scenes.question: When is Flexbox NOT the best choice?
scenes.right: Use Grid for two-dimensional layouts. Flexbox shines in one direction only.
scenes.say: A common trap: using Flexbox for complex grids. Remember, stick to Flexbox for single-axis layouts.
